title: Create automatic Agent parallel Work Item skill
outOfScope: Any global Cockpit scheduler, cross-worktree registry, or change to the one-active-Work-Item-per-worktree invariant.
Automatically creating a PR, merging, or deploying without the user-authorized Work Item lifecycle.

sources.reason: Defines the required Work Item, branch, PR, archive, and closure boundaries.
Defines WIII as a worktree-local atomic interface owned by external Agent scheduling.
Records the real integration failures and repairs that the Skill must prevent.

rawUserRequest: Skill 工单放在下一个。完成以后，用剩余的工单继续做实践，发现问题可以继续优化。并行经验 Skill 应当自动启动：接到任务先评估是否可并行；可以时制定任务边界和并行计划并实施。整个计划完成后增加自检—修复—自检循环，最后发布新版本。

declaredIntent.summary: Create and validate an automatically triggered Agent Skill for safe parallel Work Item planning, execution boundaries, and learning from practice.

riskAssessment.reason: The Skill must trigger automatically without treating worktree-local Cockpit state as a global scheduler or creating unsafe parallel Work Items.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: User explicitly directed the Skill to be created now, used for remaining Work Items, and improved from practice.

preReviewWarnings: Validate automatic triggering, safe non-parallel fallback, and the immutable-archive/current-main reconciliation rule.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A locally installed `agent-parallel-work-items` Skill has trigger metadata that activates for potentially decomposable multi-deliverable requests.
The Skill requires an Agent-owned dependency and writable-path assessment before any parallel Work Item plan, and preserves Task = Work Item = branch/worktree = PR isolation.
The Skill explicitly keeps WIII and AI Cockpit worktree-local, with no global scheduler, and requires current-main integration before archive.
The Skill is validated against the current parallelism practice and published documentation explains its automatic-use boundary.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A request contains two independent deliverables with non-overlapping paths and no lifecycle dependency.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The Skill directs an Agent to define one isolated Work Item, branch, worktree, and PR for each deliverable before scheduling them in parallel.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Forward-test the Skill against the remaining independent remediation Work Items.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Candidate Work Items share generated governance evidence or a predecessor lifecycle dependency.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The Skill serializes the conflicting work or requires a fresh current-main replacement rather than rebasing an archived Work Item.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Review the Skill dry-run matrix against the archived parallelism practice.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An Agent queries several worktrees while a Cockpit report remains active in each one.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The Skill treats each query and Cockpit report as current-worktree-local and keeps aggregate scheduling outside WIII and Cockpit.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect the Skill content and reference documentation after local validation.

intent.problem: Agents need a reusable, automatically-triggered procedure for deciding when a user request can be safely decomposed into independently governed Work Items, after practice showed that isolated branches still need current-main integration and immutable archives cannot be rebased.
constraints: Task equals Work Item equals dedicated branch/worktree equals PR.
Agent/subagents own scheduling and aggregation; WIII and Cockpit only expose worktree-local atomic state and queries.
Parallelization is conditional on independent scope, writable paths, and lifecycle dependencies.
Each Work Item must independently verify, archive, merge, close, and clean up.
The North Star remains calibrated human-agent trust through evidence, not autonomous global orchestration.
intent.rationale: Encoding the proven boundaries and failure recovery in a discoverable Skill removes the need for the user to repeat a parallelism prompt while keeping authority and evidence explicit.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized all Work Items, PRs, cleanup, the automatic parallelism Skill, iterative self-checks, and release publication.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
